text:
Anika: Kicking off a short handshake for CloudCo private offer. Goal: final publisher SSO, CMK support, per-cloud image manifests, and private SKU trial wiring. Owners?

Sanjay: I'll take SSO + minimal IAM roles. Need CloudCo SAML metadata and publisher tenant ID.

Marta: I'll own image packaging for AWS/GCP/Azure and create a single index manifest that the portal can consume. Will produce region-scoped entries.

Ellen: Legal flag: telemetry copy needs to be marketplace-friendly and call out CMK option. I'll draft a two-line blurb once events list is confirmed.

Anika: Decision: 14-day private SKU trial, one redemption per account. Marta, ensure manifest includes sku_id and trial_expiry in metadata so telemetry can correlate.

Sanjay: CloudCo contact is integrations@cloudco.io. I'll provision a staging role with s3:PutObject on publisher bucket and ec2:ImportImage. Sample minimal policy posted offline.

Marta: Manifest sample (single-line JSON entries in index): {"cloud":"aws","region":"us-east-1","image":"ami-0aa111","kms":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:333:key/kkk","sku":"cloudco-trial-14d"} We'll write index to s3://marketplace-manifests/cloudco/1765559998-index.json and equivalent GS/AZ locations.

Ellen: Telemetry events requested: app_launch, model_infer_latency_ms, sku_redeem, trial_expire, publish_error. Confirm no PII in outbound telemetry; include sku_id as string and account_hash only.

Anika: Confirmed. Internal billing may retain account_id but it will not appear in telemetry exports. Also support customer-supplied KMS ARNs per region; security review required.

pub-bot: publisher-portal: CloudCo tenant created. Upload endpoint: https://publisher.redwood.ai/hooks/cloudco-1765559998. IdP metadata pending.

Sanjay: I'll post the staging role ARN by EOD and invite CloudCo to the portal.

Marta: Filed infra ticket INF-6601 for CMK external-key support and region manifests (ETA 48h). CI jobs: build-aws-6601, build-gcp-6602, build-az-6603.

Ellen: Draft marketplace line: "Anonymous usage and error telemetry may be collected to improve service quality. Customers may supply customer-managed keys (CMKs) for image encryption; admin approval required. No customer PII is exported without consent." Will attach to package.

Anika: Nice. Next quick sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. Post blockers here. :white_check_mark:
